method: Every item is a design commitment (a mockup screen, a hosted surface, a kit board or framework, a design-doc section, a B-decision or owner rule, a brand-transition change). owners = the work packages that build or verify it; overlays = the cross-cutting brand-v2 packages (ST-48, ST-50, UK-58, UK-57) every console screen must also pass through. built = what the code has TODAY (research 2026-10-09). check.mjs recomputes statuses from workpackages.json and fails when a mockup screen has no entry, an item has no live owner and no exemption, or a UI item has no owner carrying the pkey-ux-reviewer gate.
